limits: Emulator only; no physical Android device was attached (adb devices contained only emulator-5554).

APK is arm64-v8a only and ran through the API 35 x86_64 image's arm64 translation (abilist x86_64,arm64-v8a).
No touch/input validation, no performance measurement, no release-signing verification, no on-device save/load.
AVD userdata was reused and the secure setting immersive_mode_confirmations=confirmed was set to clear the system cling; no repo config changed.
Raw evidence lives under gitignored artifacts/device/; docs/DEVICE-LAUNCH.md (Lead-owned) and records were not edited.
